name: Lemonade
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup (250 ml/8.5 oz) fresh lemon juice
¾–1 cup (160–225 g/5.6–7.9 oz) white or turbinado sugar

steps: Combine the lemon juice and sugar in a pitcher or jug. Stir until the sugar is dissolved.

culture.text: Lemonade is a sweetened lemon-flavored drink that may be carbonated or un-carbonated; when carbonated, it is sometimes called a lemon soda. There are many varieties of lemonade found throughout the world.
